decision: Keep vector dequant disabled. Stage-enabled decode medians suggested a small gain, but dequant averages overlap and diagnostic-off GPU/completion/delivery did not improve consistently. No sustained screen justified.
limitations: Short8/12-second stationary blocks, not sustained gameplay/thermal or headset quality acceptance
Submission/completion/queue selection counters do not measure unique optical fresh frames
Stationary-head ALVR total/network estimates are confounded; no optical motion-to-photon measurement
GPU clock/load are uncalibrated physical-driver endpoints outside measurements, not continuous or per-app utilization
Session/restart phase and GPU DVFS vary; one baseline ended599MHz while other endpoints640MHz
Granite stage values are delayed interval averages including preemption, not per-frame percentiles
Explicit chart source stayed2080x2208 although the driver target/SteamVR recommendation was larger; this is not a higher-source-quality comparison
